art.zoomFit: Fit the sheet to the panel
art.shrinkMessage: {{n}} drawn sprites fall outside a sheet that size. They stay in the file and come back if you grow it again, but nothing can reach them meanwhile.
art.flagsHelp: Eight bits per sprite. The engine ignores them — your game reads them with map.flag(index, bit). Flag 0 can mean solid, flag 2 water — you decide.
art.pickSprite: Sheet map — drag to pick the cells you are working on
art.deleteSheetMessage: Its art goes with it, and the sprite numbers after it shift down.

map.title: Map 0
map.shrinkMessage: {{n}} placed tiles fall outside a map that size. They stay in the file and come back if you grow it again, but nothing can reach them meanwhile.
map.gridHelp: Fine grid every tile, sky rule every eight — the screen is 20×11 tiles.
map.flagsHelp: Tints each tile by the first flag set on its sprite. Flags are per sprite, not per tile.

editor.viewerPoppedHint: The game keeps running in the floating panel and follows you across editors.

sound.sfxHelp: Numbered slots your game plays with sound.play_sfx(slot). Click a slot to put the current pattern in it; click again to clear it. A free row waits at the end, so there is always another number.
sound.clearMessage: This empties the pattern of its {{n}} notes. Anything that plays it — a music, a sound effect — keeps its place and falls silent.
sound.emptyHint: An instrument is a wave plus an envelope. Add one and the piano roll wakes up — five voices, sixteen slots.
sound.noInstrument: The inspector fills in once an instrument exists.
sound.name: Instrument name
sound.oscHelp: The raw wave. Square has a duty cycle; noise ignores pitch; PCM plays a sample.
sound.envHelp: Attack, decay, sustain, release — how loud the note is over its life.
sound.modHelp: Vibrato wobbles the pitch, arp walks a chord with one voice, the filter shapes the tone.
sound.unused: Not used yet — paint some notes.
sound.sampleHint: Any audio file. Mixed to mono and resampled to 8-bit / 8 kHz — {{seconds}} s fits the budget.
sound.zoomReset: Back to one step per cell
sound.shortenMessage: {{n}} note(s) past the new end will go. This cannot be undone.
sound.musicHelp: A music is a grid of pattern numbers, played left to right and top to bottom. Each pattern keeps its own tempo and its own length, so a chain can change speed halfway. An empty box with music after it is a hole, drawn in orange, and playing stops before it. The game reaches a music by its number: sound.play_music(0).

net.helpState: Every path the game declares, and — while a session runs — what it holds. R / W say whether joined clients may read or write a path; the host is never restricted.
net.noSession: Set a path up here before you run anything, and the flags travel with the game. The values fill in when it calls net.host() or net.join().
net.whoHelp: Everyone in this work session can take a player slot. Anyone else needs the code.
net.playersHelp: The game declared its player count with net.host(); slots fill as peers connect.
net.testHelp: Spawns a second client on this machine that joins your session, so you can test netplay alone. Latency and loss are applied to that client's outgoing frames, not to yours.
net.rigWaiting: Waiting for this client to call net.join().
net.deleteNode: Delete this node and its children
net.hostOnly: Only the host can change the shape of a path a session is holding.
net.needHost: Host a session first — run the game and call net.host().
net.relayOnlyHelp: Refuses the direct path, to measure what a relayed session costs. Real traffic through the provider, so it spends the allowance. Applies to the next session.
